chunks: O believers, if you follow what some of the people of the Book say, it will turn you into unbelievers even after you have come to belief.
ai.seo_question: What causes believers to revert to disbelief according to Surah Aal-Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a warning against *taqlid* (blind following) of non-Muslim scholars or specific Jewish and Christian sects whose teachings might contradict Islamic monotheism, potentially leading to *riddah* (apostasy). It underscores the necessity of maintaining doctrinal purity by distinguishing between beneficial knowledge and influences that erode the core tenets of faith. The verse serves as a foundational principle for evaluating external religious authorities within the broader context of Islamic jurisprudence and theology.
